weather_report:
Subiaco dozes under a clear, inky sky, the air calm and tidy, the stars unblinking as midnight draws a neat line through the night. It feels unhurried and gentle, the sort of quiet that lets you hear shoes on pavement and the soft click of a front gate. With the heavens swept clean, the morning is set to arrive bright and unsparing; sunshine will pour in early and stay faithful, the day reading crisp and high-definition. UV will be docile until dawn, then assertive by late morning, so plan for shade and a brim once the light sharpens.

Expect a pleasant, uncomplicated day: clarity that flatters the streets, a touch of warmth as the sun gathers, and little to distract from simple errands and slow pleasures. For now, a light layer is enough if you step out to breathe the cool; at first light, think easy fabrics, sunglasses, a hat, and a dab of sunscreen. It’s a good morning to put a wash on the line, water the herbs, take an unrushed walk to the corner shop, or read by an open window while the house fills with clean light. Later, a short ride to run an errand or a quiet bench in the shade will suit the mood.
